name: Bond

components.pose: She stands with her face tilted up toward the light before the great dragon, one hand raised and gently resting her palm against its snout, her other hand relaxed at her side, her face turned toward the camera with wonder and quiet certainty; the dragon's head is lowered to her and its eyes are on her; both are fully in frame.
components.headwear: a radiant crown of {{METAL}} sun-rays set with {{GEM}} stones
components.jewelry: a {{METAL}} sunburst collar with {{GEM}} stones, long ray earrings, {{METAL}} armlets
components.effects: A thread of {{MAGIC}} light runs from her palm to the dragon's brow where they touch, the bond forming, motes of light rising between them, golden light pooling and sparks of light drifting around both of them.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Lumira, an Elder Dragon of radiant rose-gold and radiant-gold scales, wreathed in soft solar glow, wings like panes of stained light edged in polished white gold, towering close beside her and lowering its great head toward her raised hand, its eyes fixed on her

notes: BOND: the first meeting with her Elder Dragon in its lair, her palm against its snout as the bond forms.
